environment.description: Same Rails 7.0 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution with origin-level response headers policy (ID: managed-security-headers-policy) that appends Strict-Transport-Security and overrides CSP. However, the PRIMARY control is the CloudFront Function (CF2) attached to the viewer-response event that injects Subresource Integrity enforcement: all <script> tags in responses are post-processed by the edge function which computes SHA-384 hashes against a pinned manifest stored in CloudFront KeyValueStore (KVS namespace: 'sri-manifest-prod', last rotated 2024-11-15). Scripts not matching a pinned hash in the manifest are stripped from the response body. Additionally, the CF2 function rewrites any script src not matching the allowlist pattern /^https:\/\/cdn\.example\.com\/[a-z0-9-]+\.js$/ to a no-op data URI. The theme_script_url parameter injection would result in a src value that fails the allowlist regex and gets rewritten to 'data:application/javascript,void(0)'. Unicode homoglyph-injected script tags would lack integrity attributes and be stripped entirely since they won't match any entry in the KVS manifest.

config.unverified_integrity_behavior: strip script tag from response body
